gap: No result ChatGPT got (of the four I could read) states that Logitech's US page for the MX Mechanical Mini for Mac lists Bluetooth Low Energy as its only connection, while Keychron's own listing limits the K3 Max's switch swapping to the "RGB Backlight Hot-Swappable Version only" and ships keycaps for both Windows and macOS; each half is already on at least one rival page, so the gap is only the side-by-side from maker pages.
standout_why: I compared against techwisereviews.com, mkbguide.com/blog/best-low-profile-mechanical-keyboards and both mechkeyfoundry.com pages. The cited RTINGS list and two RTINGS reviews returned only navigation, so the one page ChatGPT cited is unchecked. MKB Guide already says the Logitech for Mac is Bluetooth LE to three devices with no dongle, that Lofree's Cloud-series switch compatibility is narrower than Gateron/Keychron low-profile, and that the Flow 2 for Mac has a native layout. Mechkeyfoundry already says K3 Max hot-swap is on the RGB hot-swappable version and takes low-profile switches only, and that the Air75 V3 takes Gateron low-profile 3.0. TechWise already says the K3 Max only accepts Keychron or Gateron low-profile switches. None of them says which browser or connection each remapping tool needs on a Mac (Keychron Launcher, NuPhyIO, VIA for the Flow 2); that would be the real gap, but I could not open a maker page stating it, so it is in unsourced and not counted.
decides: It does not change the pick. It confirms that the Lofree Flow 2 84 for Mac belongs in the top three (MKB Guide names it for a native Mac layout; Lofree states VIA support and three connection modes), and adds two buyer cautions for the table: the Logitech for Mac is Bluetooth-only on Logitech's US page, and a K3 Max buyer who wants to swap switches must choose the RGB hot-swappable version. If the Safari/Chromium and wired-only limits for the three web remappers are sourced from maker documents later, Logitech's native macOS app (Logi Options+) becomes a real differentiator and standout would rise to 2.
